name: LCK 2027
overview: LCK's confirmed 2027 annual regional competition, run across Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 (separated by the global July competitive break), and a Championship Stage. No team placements or champions are confirmed. The LCK regional field is standardized to 8 teams for 2027; participating franchises are tracked in the pre-Worlds 2026 reference scene by 2027 regional membership, separate from Kairos's own canon team roster.
format: Stage 1: 15/02/2027 to 14/03/2027 (revised on 27/01/2027 from 01/02/2027; the end date is unchanged).
